full_page.content:
1934, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 211 Aug. 15th James Downer - 16 - 1230 Buckingham Rd. - osteomyelitis - bone in- fection - took sick a year To-day - operated on in September - very exceptional case. Only one operation i.e. day after being enrolled in Ser. Mass Association-Aug. ( 10 last week) pronounced 100% O.K.
Mrs. John Bates - non catholic - enrolled after St. Patricks' day - absolutely hopeless - now able to walk.
Mrs. Lillian Peltier - 61 - gall-bladder trouble & cancer: over- heard doctors: " .... She'll die anyhow, we might as well operat ... " refuses to have operation - demands to be sent home ..... had been a- way from sacraments many yrs. Enrolled To-day by neighbor for year - Has promised to go faithfully to Church if spared - received sacra- ments before going home.
Robert Emmet Morrissey came back Today .. .
Page 212 Aug. 17 Joseph
17 Mrs. John Ames - 44 - widow 3 yrs. five little child'n cancer of col- on - wanted to take operation .... refuses; enrolled - promises Poor Souls enrollment of 5% of threatened operation if not necessary - 50 dollars ..... Aug. 21 feels much improved. Starts enro'ing Poor SS - To- day with $5.00.
21 19 at 9:15 a.m. Mrs. Vera Adams - about 32 - Deaconess Hospital, strep- ticoctic infection now six weeks - waiting all these for strength to take blood transfusion - husband a decided "communist" Enrolled To- day by friend (she learned she ought to be Catholic)
Harry Murphy - 31 - mentally weak
Edw'd Collins
20 Helen Oley - 26 - keeping company with man twice divorced. Mother's heart sick at wedding arrangement. - 26 next month. Said man atheist.
Page 213 Page 214 Aug.
Blank Page
Debusschere case ..... Just settlement Sister Cecelia - Felician ... Sp. Int. Wm. Bey - 9 - 9 - infantile paralis ... in Kiefer Hosp.
